data.acquisitionSummary: Skinny Prepaid offers a $0 eSIM and a $2 physical Trio SIM. Current Skinny terms require adding credit at least once every 12 months; current top-up amounts start at NZ$5. New SIMs must be activated on a New Zealand network before roaming, so this is not a direct overseas-first acquisition route.

keep.action: Add credit at least once every 12 months. Current Skinny top-up amounts start at NZ$5, so NZ$5/year is the current minimum direct top-up model; recheck before each renewal because prices can change.

data.chinaActivation: BLOCKER for overseas-first acquisition: Skinny states new SIMs must be activated on New Zealand networks before a roaming pack can be used. Physical SIM and eSIM are both available, but first activation should not be assumed to work from China or another overseas location.
data.kyc: The reviewed ordinary Skinny prepaid activation flow does not state an identity-document verification step. Do not generalize this into a jurisdiction-wide no-ID claim; the hard current constraint is first activation on a New Zealand network.
data.payment: Skinny terms support top-up by Visa/Mastercard credit or debit card, voucher and other accepted methods; issuer/country acceptance should be checked at payment time.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Skinny Global Roaming supports sending and receiving text messages where the overseas network supports the service. New SIMs must first be activated on New Zealand networks.
data.holdReason: HOLD for typical overseas-only users because a new Skinny SIM/eSIM must first be activated on a New Zealand network before roaming; the retention rule itself is now directly verified.
data.tariffSummary: $0 eSIM / $2 physical SIM; current top-ups start at NZ$5 and at least one credit addition is required each 12 months. First activation must occur on a New Zealand network.
guideSteps: Acquire a Skinny eSIM or physical SIM.
Activate the new SIM on a New Zealand network before relying on roaming.
Add at least NZ$5 credit before each 12-month no-top-up window expires; recheck the current minimum before renewal.
